function.arguments: {"finding": "The email channel has significantly higher revenue than the paid_search channel, but this is confounded by customer segment. The email campaign was deliberately targeted at 'loyal' customers, who are inherently more valuable and have higher purchase rates. The paid_search channel has far more 'new' and 'returning' customers, who on average spend less. A direct comparison of channel revenue without adjusting for customer segment is misleading — it measures targeting strategy, not campaign performance.", "implication": "The raw revenue difference cannot be interpreted as the effect of the channel. The question asks which channel produced the most revenue, but the answer must account for the fact that the groups are not comparable. The email channel's higher revenue is due to targeting high-value customers, not the channel itself. Therefore, the comparison must be stratified by customer segment to isolate the channel effect."}
function.name: note_finding
